Project Title

Advanced Logistics Optimization Engine using Pandas, OR-Tools, and Real-Time Vehicle Routing Algorithms
Reference ID: ai-ml-ds-SrmZNuoOhMk
File Name: advanced_logistics_optimization_engine.py

Short Description

This project builds an intelligent logistics and delivery optimization engine leveraging pandas for data manipulation, OR-Tools for constraint-based routing, and geopy for geo-distance computations. It models real-world challenges like time windows, delivery demands, multi-vehicle constraints, and geospatial routing. Designed for enterprise-scale logistics automation, it simulates and solves complex vehicle routing problems with pro-level efficiency and clean code architecture.

# advanced_logistics_optimization_engine.py

from typing import List, Dict, Tuple
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from ortools.constraint_solver import routing_enums_pb2
from ortools.constraint_solver import pywrapcp
from geopy.distance import geodesic


# ===============================
# Services
# ===============================

class GeoDistanceService:
    @staticmethod
    def compute_distance_matrix(locations: List[Tuple[float, float]]) -> List[List[int]]:
        size: int = len(locations)
        matrix: List[List[int]] = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        for i in range(size):
            for j in range(size):
                if i != j:
                    matrix[i][j] = int(geodesic(locations[i], locations[j]).km * 1000)
        return matrix


class DemandService:
    @staticmethod
    def extract_demands(data: pd.DataFrame) -> List[int]:
        return data["demand"].tolist()


class TimeWindowService:
    @staticmethod
    def extract_time_windows(data: pd.DataFrame) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
        return list(zip(data["time_window_start"].tolist(), data["time_window_end"].tolist()))


# ===============================
# Optimizer Engine
# ===============================

class LogisticsOptimizer:
    def __init__(self, df: pd.DataFrame, vehicle_count: int = 3, vehicle_capacity: int = 15):
        self.data: pd.DataFrame = df
        self.vehicle_count: int = vehicle_count
        self.vehicle_capacity: int = vehicle_capacity
        self.manager: pywrapcp.RoutingIndexManager = None
        self.routing: pywrapcp.RoutingModel = None
        self.solution: pywrapcp.Assignment = None

    def prepare_data(self):
        self.locations: List[Tuple[float, float]] = list(zip(self.data.latitude, self.data.longitude))
        self.distance_matrix: List[List[int]] = GeoDistanceService.compute_distance_matrix(self.locations)
        self.demands: List[int] = DemandService.extract_demands(self.data)
        self.time_windows: List[Tuple[int, int]] = TimeWindowService.extract_time_windows(self.data)

    def create_model(self):
        self.manager = pywrapcp.RoutingIndexManager(len(self.distance_matrix), self.vehicle_count, 0)
        self.routing = pywrapcp.RoutingModel(self.manager)

        def distance_callback(from_index: int, to_index: int) -> int:
            from_node = self.manager.IndexToNode(from_index)
            to_node = self.manager.IndexToNode(to_index)
            return self.distance_matrix[from_node][to_node]

        self.routing.SetArcCostEvaluatorOfAllVehicles(self.routing.RegisterTransitCallback(distance_callback))

        def demand_callback(from_index: int) -> int:
            return self.demands[self.manager.IndexToNode(from_index)]

        self.routing.AddDimensionWithVehicleCapacity(
            self.routing.RegisterUnaryTransitCallback(demand_callback),
            0,
            [self.vehicle_capacity] * self.vehicle_count,
            True,
            "Capacity"
        )

        def time_callback(from_index: int, to_index: int) -> int:
            from_node = self.manager.IndexToNode(from_index)
            to_node = self.manager.IndexToNode(to_index)
            return self.distance_matrix[from_node][to_node]

        self.routing.AddDimension(
            self.routing.RegisterTransitCallback(time_callback),
            30,
            300,
            False,
            "Time"
        )

        time_dimension = self.routing.GetDimensionOrDie("Time")
        for location_idx, time_window in enumerate(self.time_windows):
            index = self.manager.NodeToIndex(location_idx)
            time_dimension.CumulVar(index).SetRange(time_window[0], time_window[1])

    def solve(self):
        search_parameters = pywrapcp.DefaultRoutingSearchParameters()
        search_parameters.first_solution_strategy = routing_enums_pb2.FirstSolutionStrategy.PATH_CHEAPEST_ARC
        self.solution = self.routing.SolveWithParameters(search_parameters)

    def get_routes(self) -> List[List[int]]:
        if not self.solution:
            return []
        routes: List[List[int]] = []
        for vehicle_id in range(self.vehicle_count):
            index = self.routing.Start(vehicle_id)
            route = []
            while not self.routing.IsEnd(index):
                route.append(self.manager.IndexToNode(index))
                index = self.solution.Value(self.routing.NextVar(index))
            route.append(self.manager.IndexToNode(index))
            routes.append(route)
        return routes

    def print_solution(self):
        routes = self.get_routes()
        for v_id, route in enumerate(routes):
            print(f"Vehicle {v_id} route: {route}")


# ===============================
# Example Use Case
# ===============================

def example_scenario():
    data: Dict[str, List] = {
        "location_id": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],
        "latitude": [52.5200, 52.5201, 52.5202, 52.5203, 52.5204],
        "longitude": [13.4050, 13.4051, 13.4052, 13.4053, 13.4054],
        "demand": [0, 1, 1, 2, 4],
        "time_window_start": [0, 5, 10, 15, 20],
        "time_window_end": [50, 55, 60, 65, 70]
    }
    df: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame(data)
    optimizer: LogisticsOptimizer = LogisticsOptimizer(df)
    optimizer.prepare_data()
    optimizer.create_model()
    optimizer.solve()
    optimizer.print_solution()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    example_scenario()
